label: sdc01_0105_brother_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Didja have trouble
getting
across
that
narrow
path?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_02
text: There it is...the Dreaded Den. This is s’posed to\nbe the ogre’s home...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_03
text: At least, that’s what everyone says. I come here\nall the time, but I’VE never seen it...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_04
text: Maybe a powerful ogre like that would only show\nup if it heard some kinda battle goin’ on...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_05
text: O-oh yeah... I think I’ve gotten a bit stronger\nsince the last time we battled, so...y’know...\r\nif you wanted to...we could battle?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_select_01
text: Let’s do it!

label: sdc01_0105_select_02
text: I don’t know...

label: sdc01_0105_brother_06
text: All right! Though, uh, we should heal up our\nteams first.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_07
text: C’mon... I’ll even heal up your Pokémon for you\nfirst, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. So please...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_08
text: I’ll give it all I got. I-I got this![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_09
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I knew it... You really are strong,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)].
How
am
I
ever
gonna
be
able
to
beat
you?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_37
text: If the ogre saw that battle, I’m sure it’d be\nthinking, “That kid’s got real strength...”[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_10
text: See, my school...Blueberry Academy...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_11
text: It’s a school that specializes in teachin’ the art of\nPokémon battlin’.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_12
text: If I was as strong as you...maybe I could aim to\nbe the best Trainer there.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_13
text: Let’s go have a look at the ogre’s den.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_14
text: Watch your head.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_15
text: See how dark it is in here? And cramped...\nEven the floor’s all rough and uneven.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_16
text: Living all alone in a place like this would get\npretty miserable, don’t you think?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_17
text: Poor ogre... We have plenty of room at our\nhouse. I would’ve totally let it stay with us...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_select_03
text: You’re a sweet kid, Kieran

label: sdc01_0105_select_04
text: When can I move in?

label: sdc01_0105_brother_18
text: N-no, I’m not! I’ve just...always liked the stories\nabout the ogre, that’s all...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_19
text: I don’t know if we’d have room for the both of\nyou, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_20
text: B-but...if the ogre really did show up to stay at\nour place, I’m sure the whole town would freak.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_21
text: Whoa, no way... The sun’s already gone down?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_22
text: I guess we’ll have to save the last signboard for\ntomorrow...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_23
text: Oh! I almost forgot!\c\nToday’s the first day of the Festival of Masks\nover at Kitakami Hall.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_24
text: It’s this big event where everyone puts on masks\nand runs around celebratin’...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_25
text: I mean, it’s not like you’ve gotta go or anything,\nbut if you wanted to...y’know...check it out...\r\nwell, it’d be fun.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_select_05
text: Let’s go together!

label: sdc01_0105_select_06
text: It does sound fun

label: sdc01_0105_brother_26
text: Y-yeah! Why not![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_27
text: I, um...I can show you to it![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_28
text: It’d be great to go together...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_29
text: There’s just a few things we’d have to get ready\nfirst, so we should swing by my house before\r\nheading to the festival.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_30
text: [EMPTY 43]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_31
text: We live in the northwest corner of the village.\nIt’s...um...let’s see, I could maybe draw a map...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_32
text: Oh, your Rotom Phone has a map in it, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_33
text: You want me to register it on your map? Yeah,\nI could give that a try...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_34
text: Wowzers! It sure is handy having a map that\nshows you everything right there in your phone...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_35
text: I’m gonna ask if I can get a Rotom Phone\nsomeday too![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: sdc01_0105_brother_36
text: I’ll be right behind you, if you wanna head to my\nfamily’s place first. See you there![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
